## SANGGAHAN DAN BATASAN TANGGUNG JAWAB DISCLAIMER AND LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Laporan  Tahunan  ini  memuat  pernyataan  kondisi keuangan, hasil operasi, proyeksi, rencana, strategi, kebijakan, serta tujuan Perseroan, yang digolongkan sebagai pernyataan ke depan dalam pelaksanaan perundang-undangan  yang  berlaku,  kecuali  halhal  yang  bersifat  historis.  Pernyataan-pernyataan tersebut memiliki prospek risiko, ketidakpastian, serta dapat mengakibatkan perkembangan aktual secara material berbeda dari yang dilaporkan.

Pernyataan-pernyataan  prospektif  dalam  Laporan Tahunan  dan  Laporan  Keberlanjutan  ini dibuat berdasarkan  berbagai  asumsi  mengenai  kondisi terkini  dan  kondisi  mendatang  Primaya Hospital serta  lingkungan  bisnis  di  mana  Perseroan  menjalankan kegiatan usaha. Pernyataan yang terdapat di Laporan Tahunan dan Laporan Keberlanjutan ini bukan menjadi jaminan kinerja di masa yang akan datang,  karena  hasil  sebenarnya  di  masa  depan dapat  berbeda  karena  dapat  dipengaruhi  oleh beberapa faktor di luar kendali Perseroan.

Laporan  tahunan  dan  Laporan  Keberlanjutan  ini memuat  kata  'Primaya Hospital '  dan  'Perseroan' yang  didefinisikan  sebagai  PT  Famon  Awal  Bros Sedaya Tbk yang menjalankan bisnis  utamanya  di bidang rumah sakit.

The Annual Report presents financial position, operational  products,  projection,  plans,  strategies, policies,  and  purposes  of  the  Company,  which  are included as the Company's forward statement under the implementation of recurring laws, except for  historical  matters.  These  statements  may  imply prospective  risks  and  uncertainties,  and  result  in actual  developments  that  differ  materially  than those reported.

The  prospective  statements  in  the  Annual  Report and  Sustainability  Report  are  written  based  on several assumption regarding the current and future  conditions  of  Primaya  Hospital  as  well  as the business environment where the Company runs its  operation.  No  statements  written  in  the  Annual Report  and  Sustainability  Report  is  a  guarantee toward the Company's future works. This is because actual results in the future may differ as they may be influenced by several factors beyond the Company's control.

The Annual Report and Sustainability Report contain the terms 'Primaya Hospital' and 'Company' which are defined as the PT Famon Awal Bros Sedaya Tbk which runs its primary business in the hospital sector.

## Taking the Lead through Transformation

Bertransformasi Menjadi yang Terdepan

Sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang kesehatan  dan  berkomitmen  untuk  membangun jaringan rumah sakit berstandar internasional dengan layanan kesehatan yang modern dan professional ,  PT  Famon  Awal  Bros  Sedaya  me­ lakukan transformasi di akhir tahun 2022 dengan melakukan Initial  Public  Offering (IPO).  Hal  ini merupakan  salah  satu  strategi  Perseroan  untuk meningkatkan pertumbuhan kinerja keuangan Perseroan.

Selain  melaksanakan  Penawaran  Saham  Perdana, Perseroan juga mengupayakan beberapa hal untuk memacu pertumbuhan Perseroan di antaranya menyediakan layanan prima yang terjangkau dan  dapat  diakses oleh  masyarakat,  menyasar segmentasi pangsa pasar yang luas, serta menerapkan standar operasional berbasis teknologi yang mengutamakan mutu dan keselamatan pasien. Perseroan juga senantiasa  memperkuat hubungan dengan seluruh  pemangku  kepentingan untuk mengembangkan layanan kesehatan lainnya yang mendukung pertumbuhan grup secara berkesinambungan, mempertahankan sumber daya utama  yakni  dokter,  perawat,  dan  tenaga  medis lainnya melalui lingkungan dan budaya kerja yang positif dan berkualitas.

Dengan  adanya  upaya-upaya  tersebut,  Perseroan mengangkat tema  ' Bertransformasi  Menjadi yang Terdepan' menjadi tema Laporan Tahunan 2022 PT Famon Awal Bros Sedaya Tbk sesuai dengan situasi serta proyek bisnis Perseroan.

As  a  company  that  focuses  on  health  sector  and commits to develop international-standardized hospital  networks  with  modern  and  professional services,  PT  Famon  Awal  Bros  Sedaya  decided  to transform  its  business  by  conducting  Initial  Public Offering  (IPO).  This  is  the  Company's  strategy  to increase its financial performance growth.

Besides  performing  an  Initial  Public  Offering,  the Company strives to conduct several business matters to trigger its growth; for instance providing affordable and publicly accessible, excellent services, targeting wide market segmentation, and applying technology-based standardized operation that prioritizes quality and safety of the patients. The Company also strives to  strengthen  its  connection with the stakeholders to develop other health care services that build sustainable group development, attain  primary  human  resources-doctors,  nurses, and other medical staffs-through positive and good quality environment as well as work culture.

By  conducting  those  efforts,  the  Company  carries 'Taking  the  Lead  through  Transformation' as  the theme of 2022 Annual Report of PT Famon Awal Bros Sedaya Tbk based on business situation and projects of the Company.

## LAPORAN DEWAN KOMISARIS REPORT OF THE BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS

## Setya Handojo Singgih

Komisaris Independen Independent Commissioner

Yos Effendi Susanto

Komisaris Utama President Commissioner

PT Famon Awal Bros Sedaya Tbk

<!-- image -->

Yang terhormat para pemegang saham dan pemangku kepentingan,

Kita bersyukur kita , Perseroan dan  Indonesia, berhasil melewati tahun 2022 yang penuh tantang­ an  dengan  baik.  Perkenankanlah  saya,  mewakili Dewan  Komisaris,  menyampaikan  laporan  Dewan Komisaris tahun 2022.

## Tinjauan tahun 2022

Dunia  kesehatan  di  Indonesia,  sepanjang  tahun 2022  ini  masih  sangat  dipengaruhi  oleh  Covid-19. Kasus Covid-19 mencapai puncaknya di bulan Februari dan Maret 2022. Jumlah kasusnya melebihi jumlah kasus saat puncak di tahun 2021. Beruntung di  tahun  2022  ini,  kasus  Covid-19  didominasi  varian Omikron, yang  gejalanya  lebih  ringan,  tidak  seberat varian Delta. Sehingga meski kasusnya lebih banyak, jumlah  kematian  karena  Covid-19  di  tahun  2022 ini,  jauh  lebih  sedikit  dibandingkan  di  tahun  2021. Dan merupakan hal yang positif, berangsur-angsur kasus Covid-19 di Indonesia mulai mereda.

Untuk penyelenggara pelayanan kesehatan, terutama yang  banyak  menangani  kasus  Covid-19, seperti Primaya Hospital , tahun 2022 adalah merupakan  tahun  dengan  tantangan  yang  berat.

The Honourable shareholders and stakeholders,

We are grateful that we, the Company and Indonesia, managed  to  pass  2022  and  its  challenges.  Please allow me, representing the Board of Commissioners, to submit the report of the Board of Coommissioners for the fiscal year 2022.

## Overview of the Year 2022

The  medical  world  in  Indonesia,  throughout  2022, remained to be affected by Covid­19. The Covid­19 cases  reached  their  peak  in  February  and  March 2022. The total cases surpassed the peak in 2021. Fortunately in 2022, Covid­19 cases  were dominated by Omicron variant, of which the symptoms were  much  milder  than  the  Delta.  Thus, even though the cases were comparably higher than the Delta, mortality rate due to Covid­19 in 2022 was relatively smaller compared to 2021. Such a positive result,  the  Covid-19  cases  in  Indonesia  gradually declined.

As for healthcare providers, particularly those providing treatment to Covid-19 survivors such as  Primaya  Hospital,  the  year  of  2022  was  a  very challenging year.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

Ada  dua  tantangan  yang  serius.  Pertama,  pada bulan  April,  Pemerintah  mengeluarkan  Keputusan Menteri Kesehatan No. 1112/2022, yang isinya menyatakan bahwa klaim tarif penanganan pelayanan Covid-19 yang diganti Pemerintah diturunkan secara drastis yakni rata-rata turun sekitar 63%.  Peraturan  ini berlaku surut,  meski baru dikeluarkan di bulan  April, tetapi berlaku sejak 1 Januari, 2022. Tantangan berat kedua ialah bahwa jumlah pasien Covid­19 yang membutuhkan pelayanan  kesehatan  menurun  curam.  Di  lain  sisi, masih  banyak  pasien  non  Covid-19  belum  berani datang  ke fasilitas kesehatan  yang selama  ini banyak menerima pasien Covid.

Maka  tak  heran,  pendapatan  Primaya  dibandingkan 2021 menurun sebesar 16,6%. Penurunan pendapatan  ini  mengakibatkan  persentase  biaya menjadi  meningkat,  terlebih  ada  beberapa  rumah sakit baru yang persentase biayanya relatif masih  tinggi.  Sehingga  semua  itu  mengakibatkan penurunan persentase keuntungan bersih yang lebih  besar  dibandingkan  penurunan  pendapatan. Namun  berkat kerja keras Direksi dan semua karyawan, secara bertahap keadaan sudah mulai  membaik.  Pendapatan  di  semester  2  jauh meningkat  dibandingkan semester 1.

## Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

Dewan  Komisaris  melihat  bahwa  selama  tahun 2022  prinsip-prinsip  tata  kelola  perusahaan  yang baik (TKPB) telah dijalankan dengan konsisten di  setiap  lini  perusahaan  dan  tingkat  organisasi. Di tahun 2022, untuk memperkuat struktur perusahaan dalam menjalankan TKPB, telah dibentuk Komite Audit, Komite Nominasi dan Renumerasi.  Terjalin  kerja  sama  yang  baik  antara Dewan Komisaris,  Dewan  Direksi,  dan  Komite­komite yang  ada.  Dewan  Komisaris  berkomitmen  untuk mendukung  implementasi  TKPB  dilakukan  dengan berkesinambungan dan  konsisten.

## Pandangan Prospek Usaha 2023

Di tengah ancaman risiko resesi di beberapa negara, para  pakar  berpandangan  bahwa  fundamental makro ekonomi Indonesia cukup kuat untuk menghindari  resesi.  Di  tahun  2023,  diproyeksikan ekonomi Indonesia akan tumbuh moderat. Pandemi sudah mereda, meski tentu tetap harus waspada.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

There  were  two  serious  challenges.  First,  in  April, the  Government  issued  the  Decree  of  Ministry  of Health  Number  1112/2022,  which  stated  that  the tariff  claim for  Covid­19 care treatment reimbursed by the Government dropped drastically, by average 63%. The regulation was retroactive; although it  was  merely  issued  in  April,  it  had  been  applied since January 1, 2022. The second tough challenge was  total  Covid­19  patients  in  need  of  healthcare treatment  plummetted.  On  the  other  hand  there was  a  plenty  of  non­Covid  19  patients  who  were frightened    to  visit  the  medical  facilities  that  at certain period had given treatment for many Covid-19 patients.

Hence,  it  was  predictable  that  the revenue  of Primaya, decreased by 16.6% from 2021. The  decline  in  revenue  resulted  in  increasing  cost percentage, particularly, several new hospitals with their relatively higher operating costs. As  a  consequence,  it  resulted  in  a  decrease  in net  profit  percentage,  higher  than  the  revenue decline. However, due to the hardwork of the Board of  Directors  and  all  employees,  the  situation  has gradually  improved  to  be  better.  The  Company's revenue  in  the  2nd  semester  increased  from  the revenue in the 1st semester.

## Good Corporate Governance

The Board of Commissioners views that throughout 2022, good corporate governance (GCG) principles had been implemented consistently in each of the Company's business lines and level of organization. In  2022,  to  strengthen  the  Company's  structure in managing GCG, the Audit Committee and Nomination  and  Remuneration  Committee  were formed.  The  collaboration  among  these  parties, Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors, and aforementioned Committees, was running well.  The  Board  of  Commissioners  is  committed to  enhancing  GCG  implementation  in  sustainable and consistent manners.

## Overview of 2023 Business Prospect

In  the  midst  of  recession  risks  occurring  in  several countries,  the  experts  view  that  the  fundamentals of Indonesia's macro economy is adequately strong to avoid recession. In 2023, the Indonesian economy is  predicted  to  experience  moderate  growth.  Even though  the pandemic  has  ended,  we  need  to maintain our awareness regarding the disease.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

Dewan  komisaris  telah  mempelajari  rencana  kerja 2023  yang  telah  disusun  Direksi  dan  tim.  Kami berpandangan bahwa rencana kerja tersebut telah dibuat  sesuai  dengan  visi,  misi,  dan  peta  jalan 2026,  juga  telah  memperhatikan  kondisi  internal dan eksternal. Target yang dibuat memang sangat menantang.  Namun dengan kerja sama yang baik dan  memegang  teguh  nilai­nilai  inti  perusahaan: PRIMA  (Profesional,  Rapi,  Ibadah,  Mendengarkan, dan Asertif),  Dewan  Komisaris  optimis  target  yang sangat menantang itu bisa tercapai. Dewan Direksi mendukung  sepenuhnya  rencana  kerja  Direksi  di tahun 2023.

<!-- image -->

The Board of Commissioners has reviewed the 2023 work  plan  designated  by  the  Board  of  Directors and  team.  We  consider  that  the  work  plan  has been  adjusted  to  the  vision,  mission,  and  2026 roadmap,  as  well  as  considered  both  internal  and external condition. The designated targets are very challenging. However,  with proper collaboration and  firmly  hold  on  the  Company's  core  values: PRIMA  (Professional,  Neat,  Worship,  Listening,  and Assertive), the Board of Commissioners is optimistic that  the  challenging  targets  would  be  achieved. The Board of Commissioner fully supports all the the Board of Directors' in 2023.

## Strategi dan Kebijakan Strategis Perseroan

Tahun  2022  merupakan  masa  pemulihan  pasca Covid-  19 sekaligus menjadi tantangan bagi berbagai  negara,  termasuk  di  antaranya  Indonesia. Pemulihan  ekonomi  yang  terbilang cukup  baik, yakni pertumbuhan PDB sebesar 5,31%  namun di  saat  yang  sama  diikuti  dengan  inflasi  5,61%. Pemulihan ekonomi dan kenaikan inflasi juga berdampak pada Perseroan sekalipun sektor kesehatan terbilang resistan terhadap krisis ekonomi.  Biaya  operasional  rumah  sakit  seperti gaji karyawan, biaya obat dan bahan habis pakai, dan  biaya  operasional  lainnya  turut  naik  sejalan dengan inflasi. Oleh karenanya Perseroan berfokus pada  upaya  peningkatan  pelayanan  pasien post pandemi, peningkatan mutu dan keselamatan pasien,  pengelolaan  keuangan  dan  pengendalian pengeluaran biaya-biaya, dan pengembangan rumah sakit sesuai kebutuhan masyarakat dan visi Perseroan.

Berbagai peningkatan pelayanan pasien post pandemi kami lakukan dengan kembali memperkuat layanan di luar Covid seperti layanan Jantung  dan  Pembuluh  Darah,  Orthopedi  Sport Clinic dan Trauma Center, Onkologi, Ibu dan Anak, dan  Urologi.  Namun  kinerja  Perseroan  mengalami tantangan  terutama  pada  semester  pertama  di tahun  2022  di  mana  terjadi  peningkatan  kasus Covid-19 secara drastis akibat varian Omikron dan dibukanya perjalanan mudik lebaran pertama kali  setelah  dua  tahun  ditutup.  Karena  sebagian layanan  rumah  sakit  bersifat  elektif,  masyarakat menunda  berobat  ke  rumah  sakit  selama  bulan Februari dan Maret 2022, dilanjutkan dengan penundaan berobat selama bulan Ramadhan April dan Mei 2022.

On this occasion, we would like to submit the report of the Board of Directors regarding the Company's strategy and strategic policy, the role of the Board of  Directors  in  formulating  strategy  and  strategic policy,  the  processes  carried  out  by  the  Board  of Directors  in  ensuring  the  implementation  of  the Company's strategy, the comparison between the  achievements  and    targets,  the  challenges encounterd  by the  Company, to the    sustainability issues by the Company.

## Corporate Strategy and Strategic Policy

2022  was  a  post­Covid  19  recovery  period  as  well as a challenge for various countries, including Indonesia.  The economic recovery was quite good, namely  GDP  growth  of  5.31%  but  at  the  same time followed by inflation  of  5.61%.   The  economic recovery and rising inflation also had an impact on the  Company,  even  though  the  health  sector  was somewhat resistant to the economic crisis.  Hospital operational costs such as employee salaries, costs  for  medicines  and  consumables,  and  other operational costs also increased in line with inflation. Therefore,  the  Company  is  focused  on  improving post-pandemic  patient  services,  improving  patient quality  and safety, managing finances and control expenses, and developing hospitals according to the community needs and the Company's vision.

We  have  made  various  improvements  to  postpandemic  patient  services  by  reinforcing  services outside  of  Covid  such  as  Cardiac  and  Vascular services, Orthopedic Sport Clinic and Trauma Center, Oncology, Mother and Child, and Urology.  However, the Company encountered challenges, especially in the first semester of 2022 where there was a drastic increase  in  Covid-19  cases  due  to  the  Omicron variant  and  the  opening  of  the  Eid  homecoming trip  for  the  first  time  after  being  closed  for  two years.    Since  some  hospital  services  were  elective, the  community  postponed  going to the  hospital  in February  and  March  2022,  followed  by  treatment delays during Ramadan in April and May 2022.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

Peningkatan  kasus  Covid­19  di  awal  tahun  2022 ini  berbeda  dengan  tahun  2021.  Kasus  Covid-19 varian Omicron menyebar lebih cepat namun tidak seganas  varian  Delta  di  tahun  2021.  Pasien  positif Omicron pada umumnya mengalami gejala ringan dan tidak membutuhkan perawatan inap di rumah sakit,  namun  membuat  masyarakat  enggan  ke rumah sakit dan menunda berobat ke rumah sakit.

Sejalan dengan penyesuaian masyarakat terhadap pandemi Covid-19, semakin banyaknya pilihan masyarakat  dalam  melakukan skrining Covid-19 termasuk  melakukan  tes  Covid-19  secara  mandiri. Hal ini menyebabkan penurunan volume permintaan test Covid-19 yang terutama berdampak di unit bisnis  laboratorium  kami.  Walaupun  terjadi peningkatan volume permintaan medical check up dari perusahaan, hal ini tidak cukup untuk menahan penurunan  kinerja  unit  bisnis  laboratorium  kami bila dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya.

Secara konsolidasian, kinerja pendapatan Perseroan  di  tahun  2022  mengalami  penurunan  bila dibandingkan  dengan  tahun  sebelumnya  sebesar 16,6% serta laba bruto sebesar 51,2%. Hal ini disebabkan  oleh  penurunan  pendapatan  dari  unit bisnis  rumah  sakit  sebesar  14,2%  dan  unit  bisnis laboratorium sebesar 30,2%.

Selain terjadinya penurunan volume pasien di awal tahun 2022,  penurunan  pendapatan  juga disebabkan adanya penyesuaian tarif jaminan dari Kementerian Kesehatan untuk Covid-19 rerata  63%.  Keputusan  Menteri  Kesehatan  Nomor HK.01.07/MENKES/1112/2022 ini ditetapkan pada April  2022  namun  berlaku  retroaktif  dari  Januari 2022,  yang  mana  sudah  terjadi  pelayanan  pasien Covid  dan  biaya-biaya  sudah  dikeluarkan  namun pembayaran  penjaminan  mengalami  penurunan. Pada tahun 2022 juga terjadi realisasi pembayaran jaminan Kementerian Kesehatan dan dilakukan kembali penyesuaian pendapatan sesuai kebijakan tarif jaminan Kementerian Kesehatan.

Sementara itu dari sisi pengeluaran terjadi peningkatan biaya­biaya akibat inflasi dan kenaik­ an  UMR,  serta  penambahan  biaya  dari  empat rumah sakit baru pada tahun 2021 dan dua rumah sakit baru pada tahun 2022 yang belum diimbangi dengan peningkatan pendapatan. Pada umumnya rumah sakit baru membutuhkan  waktu kurang lebih  1  tahun  untuk  mulai  menutupi  pengeluaran operasionalnya. Peningkatan biaya yang tidak diimbangi  dengan  peningkatan  pendapatan  menyebabkan  laba  bruto  di  tahun  2022  mengalami kontraksi.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

The  surge  of  Covid­19  cases  in  early  2022  was different  from 2021.  The Covid­19 cases of the Omicron  variant    spread  faster  but  not  as  violent as the Delta variant in 2021. Patients with Omicron Covid­19  generally  experience  mild  symptoms  and do  not  require  hospitalization,  however,  this  made people  reluctant  to  go  to  the  hospital  and  delay going to the hospital.

In  line  with  society's  adjustment  to  the  Covid­19 pandemic, there were increasing numbers of people's choices in carrying out Covid-19 screening, including carrying  out  a  Covid-19  test  independently.    This resulted in a decrease in the volume of requests for Covid­19 tests which mainly impacted our laboratory business unit.  Even though there was an increase in the volume of requests for medical check-ups from companies, this was not enough to stop the decline in  the  performance  of  our  laboratory  business  unit compared to the previous year.

On a consolidated basis, the Company's revenue  in 2022 decreased from the previous year of 16.6% and gross profit of 51.2%.  This was due to a decrease in revenue from the hospital business unit by 14.2% and the laboratory business unit by 30.2%.

In addition to the decrease in patient volume at the beginning of 2022, the decrease in income was also due  to  an  adjustment  in  the  guarantee  rate  from the Ministry of Health for Covid-19 on an average of 63%.  The decree of the Minister of Health Number HK.01.07/MENKES/1112/2022  was  enacted  in  April 2022  but  has  been  retroactively  effective  since January 2022, in which Covid patient services had occurred and costs had been incurred but guarantee payments had decreased.  In 2022, there was also a    realization  of  payment  of  guarantees  from  the Ministry  of  Health  and  re-adjustment  of  income according to the policy of the guarantee rate of the Ministry of Health.

Meanwhile,  in  terms  of  expenditure,  there  was  an increase  in  costs  due  to  inflation  and  an  increase in  the  minimum  wage,  as  well  as  the  additional costs  of  four  new  hospitals  in  2021  and  two  new hospitals  in  2022  which  had  not  been  matched  by an increase in revenue.  In general, a new hospital takes  approximately  1  year  to  start  covering  its operating expenses.  An increase in costs that was not balanced by an increase in revenue resulted in contacted gross profit in 2022.

Tata Kelola Perusahaan

Corporate Governance

Pemulihan  kinerja  Perseroan  mulai  terlihat  pada semester kedua tahun 2022. Hal ini sejalan dengan meredanya kasus Covid 19 di semester kedua tahun 2022  dan  berbagai  upaya  edukasi  kesehatan  ke masyarakat, penambahan layanan-layanan di rumah-rumah sakit baru,  dan  penguatan  layananlayanan  yang  sudah  ada  terutama  untuk  Jantung dan  Pembuluh  Darah, Orthopedi  Sport  Clinic dan Trauma Center , Onkologi, Ibu dan Anak, dan Urologi. Keberhasilan layanan Center of Excellence kami juga mulai ditawarkan untuk komunitas yang lebih  luas  melalui  program Health  Tourism dan Medical  Tourism yang  diadakan  oleh  Kementerian Kesehatan dan Kementerian Pariwisata dan Ekonomi Kreatif.

<!-- image -->

The recovery of the Company's performance began to  appear  in  the  second  half  of  2022.  This  was  in line with the easing of Covid­19 cases in the second half of 2022 and various health education programs to the public, addition of services to new hospitals, and reinforcement of existing services especially for Heart  and    Vascular,  Orthopedic  Sport  Clinic  and Trauma  Center,  Oncology,  Mother  and  Child,  and Urology.    The  success  of  our  Center  of  Excellence services  has  also  begun  to  be  promoted  to  the wider  community  through  the  Health  Tourism  and Medical Tourism programs organized by the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Tourism and Creative Economy.

Seiring dengan pemulihan kinerja pendapatan pada semester kedua tahun 2022, berbagai upaya juga dilakukan untuk pengelolaan biaya-biaya yang lebih baik. Pada semester kedua tahun 2022, Primaya Hospital Group  mulai  memperkenalkan lean  management ke  seluruh  karyawan  Perseroan mulai dari manajemen di kantor pusat, manajemen rumah sakit, sampai ke seluruh pelaksana di semua 15 rumah  sakit.  Hasilnya  mulai  terlihat di  awal tahun  2023  dengan  diadakannya  kompetisi lean management di  dalam  Primaya Hospital Group. Selain itu, pada pertengahan tahun 2022 kami juga mulai  menerapkan  sistem  pemantauan  pembelian yang terpusat yakni Central Corporate Purchasing .

Pelaksanaan Grand Opening Primaya Hospital PGI  Cikini  di  awal  tahun  2022  dan Grand Opening Primaya Hospital Depok di akhir tahun 2022 merupakan realisasi strategi pengembangan usaha Primaya Hospital Group.  Strategi  pengembangan Primaya Hospital Group menjawab kebutuhan peningkatan  infrastruktur  kesehatan  di  kota-kota strategis  di  Indonesia.  Dengan  keberadaannya  di pusat  kota  Jakarta,  Primaya Hospital PGI  Cikini yang telah beroperasi selama 124 tahun akan terus dikembangkan dalam berbagai hal baik pelayanan medis maupun non-medis secara bertahap. Keberadaan  Primaya Hospital Depok  menjawab kebutuhan tempat tidur rumah sakit di kota Depok yang saat ini rasionya masih 1,1 per 1000 penduduk, di  bawah  rasio  rata­rata  tempat  tidur  rumah  sakit di Indonesia 1,4 per 1000 penduduk.

Sesuai  dengan  visi  Primaya Hospital Group  untuk menjadi  jejaring  pelayanan  kesehatan  terkemuka berstandar  internasional,  PT  Famon  Awal  Sedaya Tbk melaksanakan penawaran umum perdana saham  Perseroan  dan  berhasil  melantai  di  Bursa Efek  Indonesia  pada  tanggal  8  November  2022.

Along  with  the  recovery  of  revenue  performance in  the  second  half  of  2022,  various  efforts  were also  made  for  a  better  cost  management.    In  the second  semester  of  2022,  Primaya  Hospital  Group began  introducing  lean  management  to  all  of  the Company's employees,  starting  from  management at  the  head  office,  hospital  management,  to  all administrators in all 15 hospitals.  The results began to appear in early 2023 with the implementation of a lean management competition within the Primaya Hospital Group.  In addition, in mid­2022 we started implementing  a  centralized  purchasing  monitoring system, namely Central Corporate Purchasing.

The Grand Opening of Primaya Hospital PGI Cikini at the beginning of 2022 and the Grand Opening of Primaya Hospital Depok at the end of 2022 are the realization of the Primaya Hospital Group's business development  strategy.    The  development  strategy of the Primaya Hospital Group responds to the need to  improve  healthcare  infrastructure  in  strategic cities  in  Indonesia.   With  its  presence  in the  center of  Jakarta,  Primaya  Hospital  PGI  Cikini,  which  has been  operating  for  124  years,  will  continue  to  be gradually developed in various ways, both in terms of medical and non­medical services.  The existence of Primaya Hospital Depok responds to the need for hospital beds in the city of Depok, where the current ratio is still 1.1 per 1000 population, below the average ratio  of  hospital  beds  in  Indonesia  of  1.4  per  1000 population.

In  accordance  with  the  Primaya  Hospital  Group's vision  to  become  a  leading  international  standard health  service  network,  PT  Famon  Awal  Sedaya Tbk  carried  out  an  initial  public  offering  of  the Company's shares and succeeded in taking the floor on  the  Indonesia  Stock  Exchange  on  November  8,

Penawaran saham perdana ini dilaksanakan untuk membuka  peluang  pendanaan  yang  lebih  luas, meningkatkan branding Primaya Hospital agar semakin dikenal masyarakat luas, dan memastikan keberlangsungan usaha Perseroan agar dijalankan secara  profesional  dengan  mengimplementasikan prinsip - prinsip tata kelola perusahaan yang baik.

## Peranan Direksi dalam Perumusan Strategi dan Kebijakan Strategis Perseroan

Dalam merumuskan strategi dan kebijakan strategi  Perseroan,  Direksi  secara  bersama-sama mengevaluasi kinerja Perseroan tahun sebelumnya, melihat kembali positioning Primaya Hospital Group dari berbagai perspektif, memahami  kekuatan, kelemahan, tantangan, serta menemukan peluangpeluang yang ada. Perumusan strategi dan kebijakan strategis Perseroan dilakukan melalui rapat Direksi maupun rapat gabungan dengan tim manajemen di bawah Direksi.

Setelah melaksanakan perumusan strategi dan kebijakan  strategis  Perseroan,  Direksi  melaporkan kepada  Dewan  Komisaris  dalam  rapat  gabungan dengan Dewan Komisaris untuk mendapatkan arahan  dan  nasihat  terkait  strategi  bisnis  terbaik bagi Perseroan sesuai dengan visi dan misi Primaya Hospital Group. Direksi terbuka atas setiap arahan dan  nasihat  yang  diberikan  oleh  Dewan  Komisaris sehingga tidak menutup kemungkinan adanya perubahan  strategi bisnis demi mencapai  hasil yang maksimal bagi Perseroan.

Dalam memastikan implementasi strategi Perseroan, Direksi Perseroan senantiasa mengevaluasi pelaksanaannya melalui laporan pertanggungjawaban secara berkala yang disampaikan masing-masing unit bisnis. ## Role of the Board of Directors in the Formulation of the Corporate Strategy and Strategic Policy

In formulating the Company's strategy and strategic policy,  the  Board  of  Directors  jointly  evaluates  the Company's performance in the previous year, reviews  the  positioning  of  the  Primaya  Hospital Group from various perspectives, understands strengths,  weaknesses,  challenges,  as  well  as  finds opportunities.    The  formulation  of  the  Company's strategy and strategic policy is carried out through meetings of the Board of Directors and joint meetings with  the  management  team  under  the  Board  of Directors.

After carrying out the formulation of the Company's strategy and strategic policy, the Board of Directors reports  to  the  Board  of  Commissioners  in  a  joint meeting with the Board of Commissioners to obtain direction  and  advice  regarding  the  best  business strategy  for  the  Company  in  accordance  with  the vision  and  mission  of  the  Primaya  Hospital  Group. The  Board  of  Directors  is  open  to  every  direction and  advice  given  by  the  Board  of  Commissioners to  provide the  opportunity for  changes  in  business strategy to achieve maximum results for the Company.

## Process Conducted by the Board of Directors in Implementing the Corporate Strategy

At the beginning of 2022, the Company's Board of Directors  explained  the  Company's  strategy  and strategic policy to all business units and hospitals so that they could be understood by all management in the Primaya Hopital Group.

In  ensuring  the  implementation  of  the  Company's strategy,  the  Board  of  Directors  of  the  Company constantly  evaluates  its  implementation  through periodic  accountability  reports  submitted  by  each business unit.  On a daily basis, the Board of Directors and  the  corporate  function  directly  monitor  the implementation  of  the  Company's  strategy  on  site by visiting  hospitals  and  other  business  units,  both

## Penerapan Tata Kelola Perseroan

Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik ( Good Corporate Governance /GCG) merupakan komitmen yang dipegang teguh oleh Perseroan dalam menjalankan bisnisnya.  Oleh  karena  itu,  Perseroan  senantiasa memastikan operasional bisnis dijalankan berdasarkan prinsip - prinsip GCG serta mengelola dan  mengendalikan  risiko-risiko  yang  berpotensi merugikan Perseroan.

Perseroan melaksanakan GCG dengan membentuk komite-komite sesuai dengan peraturan per  undangan  yang  ditujukan  bagi  Perusahaan  Terbuka  dan perbaikan SPO serta memperbarui kebijakan sesuai dengan  peraturan  perundangan, Hospital  bylaws , serta standar akreditasi pelayanan kesehatan. Penerapan seluruh aspek GCG membantu Perseroan dalam menjalankan bisnis yang berkelanjutan. Dewan Komisaris dan Dewan Direksi bekerja sama untuk mengevaluasi  dan  mengantisipasi kondisi yang dapat mempengaruhi kinerja Perseroan.

## Corporate Governance Implementation

Good Corporate Governance (GCG) is a commitment that  is  firmly  held  by  the  Company  in  running  its business.    Therefore,  the  Company  always  ensures that  business  operations  are  carried  out  based  on GCG  principles,  as  well  as  manages  and  controls risks that have the potential to harm the Company.

The Company implements GCG by forming committees in accordance with laws and regulations concerning  Public  Companies,  improving  SPO  and updating  policies  in  accordance  with  laws  and regulations, Hospital bylaws, and healthcare service accreditation standards.  The implementation of all GCG aspects helps the Company run a sustainable business.  The Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors work together to evaluate and anticipate conditions that may affect the Company's performance.

## Policy to Respond to Challenges in Implementing the Sustainability Strategy

Since  its  establishment,  the  Company  has  grown both financially and operationally.  The Company's growth is supported by the Company's sustainability values,  namely  providing  benefits  by  providing the best performance, respecting all stakeholders, being  professional,  and  forming  human  resources with integrity. The corporate culture of the Company,  namely  PRIMA,  is  built  on  the  values  of sustainability.  The Company always carries out the Company's values and code of conduct which are always the guidelines for the Company's employees in interacting with stakeholders.  To ensure that the Company  runs  its  business  in  accordance  with  its values, culture and code of conduct, the Company continuously  carries  out  internalization  in  various activities.

## Penerapan Keuangan Berkelanjutan

Sepanjang    tahun    2022,    Perseroan    senantiasa memberikan upaya terbaik untuk mewujudkan target yang telah ditetapkan. Target dan pencapaian  Perseroan  di  sepanjang  tahun    2022 di    antaranya    mampu    mencapai  peningkatan total aset lebih tinggi 26,8% dibandingkan dengan tahun 2021. Selain itu Perseroan juga berhasil mencapai  peningkatan  aset  lancar  sebesar  37,3% dan aset tidak lancar sebesar 20,3%.

Sementara  di  bidang  lingkungan,  di  tahun  2022 Perseroan berhasil menghemat air sebesar 93.477.000  liter,  lebih  rendah  31%  dibandingkan dengan  tahun 2021. Penurunan  yang signifikan ini    merupakan    hasil  dari    upaya    pengendalian penggunaan  air  yang  dilakukan  secara  tertib  dan disiplin.

Di  bidang  sosial,  Perseroan  sepanjang  tahun  2022 telah    berhasil  mengadakan  250  kegiatan  CSR dengan  biaya  setara  Rp10,8  miliar  yang  ditujukan kepada penduduk di sekitar wilayah operasi Perseroan  dan  sebagian  kepada  penduduk  yang membutuhkan  di  luar  wilayah  operasi  Perseroan. Jumlah kegiatan ini meningkat 346% dibandingkan jumlah  kegiatan  CSR  di  tahun  2021.  Peningkatan jumlah  kegiatan  ini  dilakukan  untuk  menjangkau masyarakat secara lebih luas.

## Sustainable Finance Implementation

Throughout  2022,  the  Company  always  made  the best efforts to realize the set targets.  The Company's targets and achievements throughout 2022 include being  able  to  achieve  a  higher  increase  in  total assets of 26.8% from 2021. In addition, the Company also succeeded in achieving an increase in current assets of 37.3% and non­current assets of 20.3%.

Meanwhile in the environmental sector, in 2022 the Company  managed  to  save  water  by  93,477,000 liters, 31% lower that in 2021. This significant decrease was the result of efforts to control water use which were carried out in an orderly and disciplined manner.

In the social sector, throughout 2022 the Company succeeded in holding 250 CSR activities with a cost equivalent  to  IDR  10.8  billion  which  were  aimed  at residents  around the Company's operational areas and some to residents in need outside the Company's operational  areas.  The  number  of  these  activities increased by 346% from the number of CSR activities in 2021. The increase in the number of these activities was due to an effort to reach a wider community.

## Peningkatan Mutu dan Keselamatan

Sebagai  penyedia  jasa  pelayanan  kesehatan,  kami berkomitmen  untuk  terus  meningkatkan  mutu  dan keselamatan  pasien  di  seluruh  Primaya Hospital .  Salah satu buktinya adalah pada tahun 2022 kami berhasil mempertahankan  akreditasi  internasional  dari Joint Commission International yang sudah kami raih sejak  tahun  2014  khususnya  untuk  Primaya Hospital Bekasi Barat dan Primaya Hospital Tangerang. Standar internasional dari Joint Commission International ini juga kami terapkan ke seluruh rumah  sakit  dalam  Primaya Hospital Group  melalui standar  operasional  dan  kebijakan  yang  terpusat. Selain  itu,  kami  memperkuat  tim  mutu  dan  berhasil melaksanakan audit mutu internal secara berjenjang baik  di  level  rumah  sakit,  kluster,  maupun  korporat yang  dilakukan  secara  berkala  untuk  memastikan standar  akreditasi  betul  betul  dijalankan  sehari  -hari. Untuk meningkatkan budaya mutu dan keselamatan pasien,  kami  terus  menekankan  budaya  'Speak  Up' dari  lini  yang  paling  bawah,  memberikan  perhatian khusus terhadap peningkatan pelaporan insiden dan mendukung berbagai usaha perbaikan.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

financial  risk,  environmental  risk,  and  social  risk. The  Company  periodically  carries  out  the  process of identifying, analyzing, mitigating, evaluating, monitoring,  and  communicating  operational  risks to  the  hospital  business  that  have  the  potential  to harm and hinder the achievement of the Company's targets.    In  addition,  the  Company  pays  attention to operational risks in the social and environmental sectors that may threaten the Company's business continuity and  reputation.

## Whistleblowing System Management in the Company

We  already  have  a  whistleblowing  system  with a  clear  legal  basis  and  system.    We  also  routinely carry out socialization on the existing whistleblowing system, and we are fully committed to the rights of whistleblowers during reporting investigations while maintaining the confidentiality of the identity of the whistleblowers  and  avoiding  potential  conflicts  of interest in the Company.

## Quality and Safety Improvement

As a provider of healthcare services, we are committed to continuously improving the quality and safety of patients throughout Primaya Hospital.  This is indicated by the fact  that in 2022 we succeeded in maintaining international accreditation from the Joint  Commission  International  which  we  have achieved since 2014, especially for Primaya Hospital West Bekasi and Primaya Hospital Tangerang.  We also  applied  this  international  standard  by  Joint Commission  International  to  all hospitals within the  Primaya  Hospital  Group  through  centralized operational standards and policies.  In addition, we strengthened  our  quality  team  and  succeeded  in carrying out internal quality audits regularly at the hospital, cluster, and corporate levels to ensure that accreditation  standards  are  properly  implemented on a daily basis.   To  improve the  culture  of  quality and  patient  safety,  we  continue  to  emphasize  the 'Speak Up' culture from the bottom line, pay special attention to increasing incident reporting and support various improvement efforts.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

Di tahun 2022 ini kami berhasil  merampungkan sistem pelaporan  insiden di seluruh Primaya Hospital sehingga    kami    dapat    cepat    melakukan root cause analysis , tindak lanjut, dan evaluasi tindak lanjut.  Dengan  adanya sistem ini,  diharapkan  dapat mempermudah rumah sakit dalam melaporkan insiden  yang  terjadi.  Terdapat  5  jenis  insiden  yaitu Kondisi Potensial Cedera (KPC), Kejadian Nyari Cedera (KNC), Kejadian Tidak Cedera (KTC), Kejadian Tidak Diharapkan (KTD) dan Sentinel. Dengan  meningkatnya  kesadaran  pelaporan  KPC dan  KNC,  diharapkan  dapat  menekan  insiden  KTC, KTD serta sentinel. Sampai dengan akhir 2022 terjadi peningkatan pelaporan KNC sebesar 34% dan KPC  sebesar  36%  bila  dibandingkan  dengan  tahun sebelumnya,  diiringi  dengan  penurunan  angka  KTD sebesar 16%.

<!-- image -->

In  2022,  we  succeeded  in  completing  an  incident reporting  system  throughout  Primaya  Hospital  so that  we  were  able  to  quickly  carry  out  root  cause analysis,  follow­up  and  follow­up  evaluation.  This system is  expected to facilitate  hospitals to  report incidents that occur. There are 5 types of incidents, namely Potential Injuries (KPC), Near-Miss Incidents (KNC),  Non-Injury  Incidents  (KTC),  Adverse  Events (KTD)  and  Sentinels.  With  increased  awareness  of KPC  and  KNC  reporting,    KTC,  KTD  and  sentinel incidents  are  expected  decline.    Until  the  end  of 2022, there was an increase in KNC reporting by 34% and  KPC  by  36%  when  compared  to  the  previous year, along with a decrease in the number of adverse events by 16%.

## Penerapan Manajemen Risiko

Kami juga mengelola dan memonitor risiko melalui  sistem  yang  disebut  'Primaya  Mutu',  yang berfungsi mengidentifikasi risiko, mengagregasi data, memantau dan mengevaluasi rencana pengendalian/kontrol secara lebih terfokus.

Perseroan mengategorikan risiko menjadi dua, yaitu risiko klinis dan non klinis. Temuan risiko dimasukkan  ke  dalam risk register oleh  masingmasing  unit di rumah  sakit  dalam  bentuk  kode khusus  yang  ditentukan berdasarkan  standarisasi JCI  ( Joint  Commission  International ).  Masing  -masing rumah  sakit  menyusun  program  manajemen  risiko secara  tahunan,  yang  kemudian  hasil  pengendalian dilaporkan setiap 6 bulan sekali. Dari laporan masing  masing rumah  sakit, disusun ' Heat  Map ' . Heat map membantu mengidentifikasi grading risiko sebelum  dan  setelah  kontrol  dilakukan  berdasarkan dampak dan frekuensi kejadian. Manajemen risiko ini disosialisasikan  melalui  pelatihan  manajemen  risiko yang diikuti oleh seluruh rumah sakit dan unit untuk memastikan  pengendalian  risiko  berjalan  dengan baik.

## Risk Management Implementation

We also manage and monitor risks through a system called  'Primaya  Mutu',  which  functions  to  identify risks, aggregate data, monitor and evaluate control plans/controls in a more focused manner.

The  Company  categorizes  risks  into  two,  namely clinical  and  non­clinical  risks.    Risk  findings  are entered  into  the  risk  register  by  each  unit  in  the hospital  in  the  form  of  a  special  code  determined based on JCI (Joint Commission International) standards. Each hospital develops a risk management  program  on  an  annual  basis,  which then  reports  control  results  every  6  months.    From the reports of  each  hospital,  a  'Heat  Map'  is compiled.  The heat map helps identify risk grading before and after control is carried out based on the event impact and frequency. This risk management is  disseminated  through  risk  management  training which is attended by all hospitals and units to ensure risk control is running well.

## RIWAYAT SINGKAT PERSEROAN A BRIEF HISTORY OF THE COMPANY

PT Famon  Awal  Bros  Sedaya  TBK  ('Perseroan') didirikan pada tahun 1997 dengan nama PT Famon Global Raya, dan kemudian, pada tahun 2016, Perseroan melakukan perubahan nama menjadi PT Famon Awal Bros Sedaya berdasarkan  Akta  Pernyataan  Keputusan  Rapat No.  188,  tanggal  14  Oktober  2016  yang  dibuat  di hadapan  Jose  Dima  satria,  S.H.,  M.Kn.,  Notaris  di Jakarta yang telah  distujui  oleh  Menteri  Hukum  dan Hak  Asasi  Manusia  Republik  Indonesia  berdasarkan Surat  Keputusan  No.  AHU-0019035.AH.01.02.TAHUN 2016 tanggal 17 Oktober 2016.

Pada  tahun  2022,  Perseroan  kemudian  mengubah stastus  perusahaan  menjadi  perusahaan  terbuka, dan secara resmi melakukan pencatatan saham di Bursa Efek donesia atau go public pada tanggal 8 November 2022.

Grup  Primaya Hospital merupakan  grup  rumah sakit swasta di Indonesia dengan berbagai pelayanan komprehensif yang menargetkan segmen  kelas  menengah  ke  atas.  Grup  Primaya Hospital didirikan  pada  tahun  1997  oleh  Profesor Yos  Effendi  Susanto  yang  telah  berkiprah  dalam pendirian dan pengoperasian rumah sakit sejak tahun 1988 dan juga merupakan salah satu pendiri grup rumah  sakit Mitra Keluarga. Pada  tahun  2006,  Profesor  Yos  Effendi  Susanto mendirikan  Rumah  Sakit  Global  Medika  berlokasi di  Tangerang  dan  menawarkan  100  tempat  tidur. Selanjutnya,  pada  tahun  2007,  Perseroan  bermitra dengan Rumah Sakit Awal Bros yang dikelola oleh Ir.  H.  Arfan  Awaloeddin,  MARS,  untuk  mendirikan Rumah  Sakit  Global  Awal  Bros  di  Bekasi  pada tahun 2008 dan pada tahun 2011, menyeragamkan nama rumah sakit yang didirikan dan/atau diakuisi menjadi  Rumah  Sakit  Awal  Bros.  Pada  bulan  April 2020,  Perseroan  melakukan rebranding menjadi 'Primaya Hospital '  dan  sejak  pendiriannya,  Grup Primaya Hospital telah  berkembang  pesat,  hingga akhir  tahun  2022  disebutkan  memiliki  lebih  dari 2000 tempat tidur.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

PT  Famon Awal Bros Sedaya Tbk ('Company') was established  in  1997  under  the  name  of  PT  Famon Global Raya, and in 2016, the Company changed its name into  PT  Famon Awal  Bros  Sedaya  according to  the  Deed  of  Statement  of  Meeting  Resolution Number  188,  dated  October  14,  2016  made  in  the presence  of  Jose  Dima  Satria,  S.H.,  M.Kn.,  Notary in  Jakarta,  which  was  approved  by  the  Ministry  of Justice  and  Human  Rights  through  the  Decree Number  AHU­0019035.AH.01.02.YEAR 2016 dated October 17, 2016.

In 2022, the Company changed its status to limited liability  company,  and  officially  listed  its  shares on  the  Indonesia  Stock  Exchange  or  go  public  on November 8, 2022.

Primaya Hospital Group is a private hospital group in Indonesia with several comprehensive services targeting middle to upper class communities. Primaya  Hospital  Group  was  established  in  1997  by Professor Yos Effendi Susanto, who has been serving as an expert at developing and operating hospitals since  1988  and  is  one  of  the  founders  of  Mitra Keluarga.  In  2006,  Professor  Yos  Effendi  Susanto founded  Global  Medika  Hospital,  which  is  located in Tangerang and offers 100 hospital beds. In 2007, the Company collaborated with Awal Bros Hospital managed by Ir. H. Arfan Awaloeddin, MARS, to set up Global Awal Bros Hospital in Bekas in 2008. In 2011, the  name  of  the  established  or  acquired  hospitals was changed into Awal Bros Hospital. The Company rebranded  on  its  name  into  'Primaya  Hospital'  in April  2020,  The  company  rebranded  to  become 'Primaya Hospital' and since its establishment, the Primaya  Hospital  Group  has  grown  rapidly.  By  the end of 2022, it has more than 2000 beds.

## KEGIATAN USAHA PERSEROAN

## CORPORATE BUSINESS ACTIVITIES

Grup Primaya Hospital merupakan grup rumah sakit swasta  di  Indonesia  dengan  berbagai  pelayanan komprehensif yang menargetkan segmen kelas menengah ke atas. Primaya menawarkan berbagai pelayanan  kesehatan  di  antaranya  pusat  layanan ibu dan anak, pusat layanan jantung dan pembuluh darah, pusat layanan trauma, pusat layanan kanker, pusat layanan urologi, brain and neurocenter , pusat layanan mata, serta sports  clinic  and  orthopaedic center .  Selain  layanan-layanan  di  atas,  Primaya juga  menawarkan  pelayanan  laboratorium  klinis, homecare , medical evacuation , serta berbagai layanan kesehatan lainnya.

Dalam rangka ekspansi usaha, Perseroan berencana juga untuk melakukan pendirian rumah sakit­rumah  sakit  baru  dan/atau  akuisisi  rumah sakit,  klinik,  atau  layanan  kesehatan  lainnya  yang berpotensi  baik  dan  dapat  menciptakan  sinergi dengan kegiatan usaha dan strategi Grup Primaya Hospital saat  ini.  Saat  ini  Grup  Primaya Hospital berkantor  pusat  di  Ruko  Mega  Grosir  Cempaka Mas  Blok  N/21  Sumur  Batu,  Kemayoran,  Jakarta. Dalam menjalankan kegiatan usahanya, Perseroan membagi  rumah  sakit  ke  dalam  empat  klaster regional  utama  yaitu  Klaster  Tangerang,  Klaster Bekasi, Klaster Jakarta, dan Klaster Makassar. Sampai dengan tanggal 31 Desember 2022, Perseroan  melalui  Perusahaan  Anak  memiliki  15 rumah sakit yang telah beroperasi di wilayah Pangkalpinang, Depok, Bekasi, Tangerang, Jakarta, Karawang, Sukabumi, Semarang, Palangkaraya, dan Makassar.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

Primaya Hospital Group is a private hospital group in Indonesia with a number of comprehensive services targeting middle to upper class communities. Primaya  offers  several  health  care  services  such as mother and child center, heart and blood vessel center, trauma center, cancer center, urology department,  brain  and  neurocenter,  eye  center, and  sports  and  clinic  and  orthaopaedic  center.  In addition, Primaya  also  offers  clinical  laboratory service,  homecare,  medical  evacuation,  as  well  as other various health care services.

In  order  to  expand  its  business,  the  Company  also plans  to  develop  new  hospitals  and/or  acquire hospitals,  clinics,  or  other  health  care  institutions that demonstrate good potential and create synergy with  current  business  activities  and  strategies  of Primaya Hospital Group. Currently, Primaya Hospital Group's headquarter is at Ruko Mega Grosir Cempaka Mas Blok N/21 Sumur Batu, Kemayoran, Jakarta. In conducting  its  business,  the  Company  divides  the hospitals  into  four  main  regional  clusters,  which consist of Tangerang Cluster, Bekasi Cluster, Jakarta Cluster, and Makassar Cluster. Until  December 31,  2022,  the  Company  through  its  Subsidiaries owns 15 hospitals operated in Pangkalpinang, Depok, Bekasi, Tangerang, Jakarta, Karawang, Sukabumi, Semarang, Palangkaraya, and Makassar.

## DAFTAR KEANGGOTAAN ASOSIASI INDUSTRI LIST OF INDUSTRY ASSOCIATION MEMBERSHIP

## KRONOLOGIS PENCATATAN SAHAM

## CHRONOLOGY OF SHARE LISTING

Pada tanggal 8 November 2022, Perusahaan mencatat saham di Bursa Efek Indonesia sebanyak 13.959.422.300  lembar  saham.  Pada  tanggal  29 Oktober  2022,  Perusahaan  memperoleh  pernyataan  efektif  dari  Kepala  Eksekutif  Pengawas  Pasar Modal  Otoritas  Jasa  Keuangan  dengan  suratnya nomor S­215/D.04/2022 untuk melakukan Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham dengan jumlah keseluruhan sebanyak 302.222.300 saham atau mewakili 2,17% saham di Perseroan.  Bersamaan  dengan  Penawaran Umum  Perdana  Saham,  Perseroan  juga  menerbitkan  sebanyak  697.000.000  (enam  ratus  sembilan puluh  tujuh  juta)  saham  biasa  atas  nama  dalam rangka pelaksanaan MCB  kepada  Archipelago Investment Pte. Ltd atau mewakili 4,99% saham di Perseroan.

Saham-saham tersebut telah dicatatkan pada Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) pada tanggal 8 November 2022, dengan kode saham PRAY.

Sejak status Perseroan menjadi perusahaan terbuka dan pencatatan saham Perseroan di Bursa Efek  Indonesia,  tidak  terdapat  aksi  korporasi  yang mencakup pemecahan saham, penggabungan saham,  dividen  saham,  saham  bonus,  perubahan nilai nominal saham.

<!-- image -->

## INFORMASI PENCATATAN EFEK LAINNYA

INFORMATION ON OTHER SECURITIES REGISTRATION

Sementara  sepanjang  tahun  2022,  tidak  terjadi pencatatan  efek  lainnya  yang  belum  jatuh  tempo pada tahun 2022.

While  throughout  2022,  there  was  no  securities registration due in 2022.

On November 8, 2022, the Company listed 13,959,422,300 shares on the Indonesia Stock Exchange.  On  October  29,  2022,  the  Company obtained  effective  statement  from  the  Executive Chief  of  Capital  Market  Supervisory  of  Financial Services  Authority  with  his  letter  number  S­215/ D.04/2022  to  conduct  an  Initial  Public  Offering with  a  total  of  302,222,300  shares  or  representing around 2.17% of shares in the Company. Along with the Initial Public Offering, the Company also issued 697,000,000  (six  hundred  and  ninety­seven  million) ordinary  shares  in  the  implementation  of    MCB  to Archipelago Investment Pte. Ltd, representing 4.99% shares in the Company.

These  shares  were  listed  on  the  Indonesia  Stock Exchange (IDX) on November 8, 2022, with the PRAY stock code.

By  the  time  the  Company  status  changed  into  a limited  liability  company  and  it  enlisted  its  shares on  the  Indonesia  Stock  Exchange,  there  has  not been  any  corporate  action  including  shares  split, stock combination, stock dividend, bonus shares or changed in the nominal value of shares.

## SUMBER DAYA MANUSIA HUMAN RESOURCES

## Proses Rekrutmen

SDM adalah bagian organisasi yang mampu menjadi fondasi bagi pengembangan bisnis secara berkelanjutan. Oleh karena itu, Perusahaan menekankan pentingnya pengelolaan SDM sebagai aset  bagi  Perusahaan  untuk  memberikan  kinerja yang  berkesinambungan,  dan  mencapai  visi  dan misi Perusahaan.

Sebagai salah satu pemangku kepentingan, SDM  memiliki kepentingan besar  terhadap laju perkembangan  Perusahaan.  Selain  itu,  SDM  juga menjadi  salah  satu  keunggulan  kompetitif  untuk mendukung  tercapainya  target  yang  ditetapkan sekaligus untuk menghadapi perkembangan teknologi dan perubahan pada industri. Untuk itu,  Perusahaan  merumuskan  kebijakan  strategis terkait pengembangan SDM yang diharapkan mampu meningkatkan produktivitas, sekaligus memberikan  dampak  positif  bagi  perkembangan talenta pegawai.

Strategi  dan  pengelolaan  sumber  daya  manusia senantiasa  disesuaikan  dengan  strategi  Perusahaan baik strategi jangka pendek, menengah dan jangka  panjang.  Hal  tersebut  merupakan  salah satu  upaya  Perusahaan  untuk  memastikan  sumber daya  manusia  Perusahaan  memiliki  kompetensi, keahlian  dan  komitmen  serta  responsif  terhadap perkembangan  namun  tetap  berpegang  kepada nilai-nilai dan budaya Perusahaan.

Pengelolaan  SDM  Perusahaan  dimulai  dari  proses rekrutmen yang  didasarkan  pada  jumlah  kebutuhan untuk memenuhi pengembangan struktur organisasi, lalu diikuti dengan pengembangan kompetensi, penilaian dan memberikan kompensasi kepada karyawan, memperhatikan hubungan kerja,  kesehatan,  keamanan  dan  keadilan  tanpa memandang ras, agama, dan gender serta mempertimbangkan juga disabilitas.

Perusahaan  melakukan  proses  rekrutmen  melalui proses perencanaan kebutuhan karyawan di mana bagian  SDM  akan  menganalisa  dan  mengevaluasi kebutuhan karyawan terlebih dahulu dan kemudian mengajukan  usulan kebutuhan SDM  ke Direksi. Setelah mendapat persetujuan Direksi, pelaksanaan rekrutmen dapat dilakukan Perusahaan.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

## Recruitment Process

Human resources are the foundation for sustainable business development. Therefore,  the  Company emphasizes the importance of human management as an asset for the Company to provide sustainable performance and achieve the vision and mission of the Company.

As  one  of  the  stakeholders,  human  resources  play important roles in the Company';s progress. Besides, human  resources  also  play  a  role  to  be  one  of Company's competitive advantages to support designated target achievement as well as to address any technological advancement and transformation in the respective industry. Thus, the Company formulates strategic policies regarding human resource development that is expected to enhance productivity and positive impacts for the employee talent development.

The strategy and management of Human Resources are constantly adjusted to the strategies of the Company, whether it is short­term, mid­term, and long­term strategies. This is the Company's effort to ensure that the human resources of the Company are competent, professional, and committed as well as  responsive  towards  the  development  while  still upholding the values and culture of the Company.

The human resource management in the Company starts with recruitment process based on the needs to  fulfill  organizational  structure  development.  It  is followed by competency develop  ment, assessment and  grant  of  compensation  for  the  employees, working relationsip monitoring, health, security and justice  regardless  of  races,  religion,  and  gender  as well as considering disabilities.

The Company conducts recruitment process through workforce planning process where the human resource  department  analyzes  and  evaluates  the needs for workers. Then, it submits human resources needs  proposal  to  the  Board  of  Directors.  After obtaining approval from the Board of Directors, the recruitment process is implemented.

## Pelatihan  dan  Pengembangan  Kemampuan Karyawan

Sepanjang tahun 2022, Perseroan memberi fasilitas kepada seluruh karyawan untuk berpartisipasi dalam program pelatihan, konferensi, seminar, dan/ atau workshop ,  baik  yang  dilakukan  secara  internal maupun eksternal. Pelatihan yang dilaksanakan oleh Perseroan diklasifikasikan ke dalam 4 (empat) jenis pelatihan,  di  antaranya  orientasi,  pelatihan  medis, pelatihan nonmedis, dan pelatihan kepemimpinan.

## 1. Orientasi

Program Orientasi merupakan program yang wajib dilaksanakan oleh setiap karyawan baru Perseroan. program  ini  dibagi  menjadi  2  (dua)  jenis,  yakni orientasi umum  dan orientasi khusus. Program orientasi  khusus  merupakan  pengenalan  secara luas  tentang  Perseroan,  seperti visi,  misi,  nilai,  dan pengetahuan dasar mengenai Perseroan.

Sementara  program  orientasi  khusus  merupakan pengenalan secara lebih detail mengenai unit masing­masing  karyawan.  Khusus  bagi  perawat, dilaksanakan  juga  pendampingan  ( preceptorship ) selama masa orientasi.

The  entire  healthcare  services  of  the  Company  is supported  by  800  specialty  doctors  (full-time  and or part-time doctors and including dental specialist), and 2,078 nurses and midwives, as well as 895 other medical support staffs.

The Company also has specialist doctors totaling 901 doctors who are assigned in various hospitals.

## Training and Competency Development of the Employees

Throughout 2022, the Company provided facilities for all employees to participate in training programs, conferences, seminars and/or workshops, both conducted internally and externally. The training  carried  out  by  the  Company  is  classified into 4 (four) types of training, including orientation, medical training, non-medical training, and leadership training.

## 1. Orientation

Orientation  program  is  a  compulsory  program  for each new employee of the Company. This consists of  2  (two)  types:  general  orientation  and  specific orientation.  The general orientation is  a  broad introduction program regarding the Company, such as  vision,  missions,  values,  and  basic  knowledge about the Company.

Meanwhile,  specific  orientation  program  is  a  more detailed  introduction  about  the  unit  where  each employees  works.  Especially  for  nurses,  preceptor­ ship is also carried out during the orientation period.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

## 2. Pelatihan Medis

Program  pelatihan  medis  di  Perseroan  dilakukan dalam rangka pemenuhan kopetensi profesi medis seperti  dokter,  perawat,  farmasi,  dan  sejenisnya. Program  pelatihan  ini  merupakan  benruk  upaya Perseroan dalam meningkatkan keterampilan tenaga medis pada bidangnya masing-masing dari narasumber internal dan eksternal.

## 3.  Pelatihan Nonmedis

Program pelatihan nonmedis merupakan pelatihan yang ditujukan bagi seluruh karyawan dalam upaya meningkatkan  mutu  layanan  dan  meningkatkan wawasan seputar perkembangan karier.

Internal (Pelatihan perawat ICU dasar) Internal (Basic ICU Nurses Training)

Service excellence

## TINJAUAN EKONOMI DAN INDUSTRI TAHUN 2022

## ECONOMIC AND INDUSTRIAL OVERVIEW IN 2022

Berdasarkan data Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), kinerja  ekonomi  Indonesia  terus  menguat  pada triwulan  III  2022,  di  tengah  perlambatan  ekonomi global dan kenaikan inflasi domestik. Perkembang­ an tersebut tercermin pada pertumbuhan ekonomi triwulan  III  2022  yang  mencapai  5,72%  (yoy),  lebih tinggi  dari  capaian  triwulan  sebelumnya  sebesar 5,45% (yoy). Kinerja ekonomi  yang tetap kuat tersebut ditopang oleh berlanjutnya perbaikan permintaan  domestik  dan  tetap  tingginya  kinerja ekspor. Perbaikan ekonomi nasional juga tercermin pada kinerja berbagai lapangan usaha dan seluruh wilayah  yang  tetap  baik.  Ke  depan,  pertumbuhan ekonomi  diprakirakan  tetap  kuat  didorong  oleh perbaikan  permintaan  domestik  sejalan  dengan terus meningkatnya mobilitas dan berlanjutnya penyelesaian Program Strategis Nasional (PSN). Namun  demikian,  dampak  perlambatan  ekonomi global terhadap kinerja ekspor dan potensi tertahannya konsumsi rumah tangga akibat kenaikan inflasi patut diwaspadai.

Dari sisi pengeluaran, hampir seluruh  komponen menunjukkan  pertumbuhan  yang  positif.  Konsumsi rumah tangga tumbuh tinggi sebesar 5,39% (yoy), melambat dibandingkan capaian triwulan sebelumnya  5,51%  (yoy).  Pertumbuhan  yang  tetap tinggi tersebut sejalan dengan peningkatan mobilitas masyarakat, masih terbatasnya dampak penyesuaian harga  Bahan  Bakar  Minyak  (BBM), serta  adanya penyaluran bantuan sosial dan subsidi energi. Kinerja investasi juga  membaik  dengan  tumbuh  sebesar 4,96%  (yoy),  terutama  investasi  non  bangunan  baik mesin  maupun  peralatan.  Sementara  itu,  konsumsi Pemerintah  masih  terkontraksi  sebesar  2,88%  (yoy) yang bersumber dari penurunan belanja barang untuk Penanganan Covid-19 dan Pemulihan Ekonomi Nasional (PC-PEN). Peningkatan ekspor terus berlanjut dengan pertumbuhan mencapai 21,64% (yoy), ditopang  oleh  permintaan  mitra  dagang  utama  yang tetap kuat dan kebijakan percepatan ekspor minyak kelapa sawit. Impor juga tumbuh tinggi sebesar 22,98% (yoy)  seiring  dengan  kinerja  permintaan  domestik dan ekspor yang tetap tinggi.

According to the Central Bureau of Statistics (BPS), Indonesia's economic performance continued to  strengthen  in  the  third  quarter  of  2022,  amidst the global economic slowdown and domestic inflation  rise.  This  development  was  reflected  in economic growth in the third quarter of 2022 which reached  5.72%  (yoy),  higher  than  the  achievement in  the  previous  year  of  5.45%  (yoy).  The  economic performance, which remained strong, was reinforced by  continuing  improvement  in  domestic  demand and constantly high export performance. The improvement  in  the  national  economy  is  reflected in  the  performance  of  various  business  fields  and all  regions  which  remains  positive.  In  the  future, the economic growth is predicted to remain strong driven  by  improving  domestic  demand  in  line  with the continued increase in mobility and  completion of  the  National  Strategic  Program  (PSN).  However, we should be cautious about the impact of the global economic slowdown on export performance and the potential for restrained household consumption due to rising inflation.

In  terms  of  expenditure,  almost  all  components showed  positive  growth.  Household  consumption increased  5,39%  (yoy),  slower  than  the  previous quarter  achievement  of  5,51%  (yoy).  The  constant growth  was  in  line  with  public  mobility  increase, limited  effect  of  gasoline  (BBM)  price  adjustment, and  social  aid  and  energy  subsidy  disbursement. Investment  performance  also  improved  with  the growth of 4.96% (yoy), especially non­building investment, both machinery and equipment. Meanwhile,  government  consumption  experienced contraction  of  2,88%  (yoy)  due  to  a  decrease  in goods expenditure for Handling Covid 19 and National Economic Recovery (PC­PEN). Export performance  improvement  continued  to  increase reaching 21,64% (yoy), supported by primary trading partner demand which remained strong and palm oil export acceleration policy. Import performance grew high by 22,98% (yoy) in line with  the performance of domestic and export demand which remained high.

Dilansir dari Berita Resmi Statistik Triwulan III­ 2022  yang  dipublikasi  oleh  Badan  Pusat  Statistik, produksi lapangan usaha jasa Kesehatan dan kegiatan  sosial  mengalami  pertumbuhan  tertinggi hingga  7,12%  dari  triwulan sebelumnya  (q­to­q), namun  terkontraksi  sebesar  ­1,74%  dari  triwulan III tahun 2021 (yoy). Namun demikian, sektor Kesehatan diklaim berhasil  mencatatkan  berbagai capaian positif sepanjang tahun 2022, mulai dari penanganan  Covid-19  dan  vaksinasi, serta transformasi Kesehatan.

<!-- image -->

According  to  the  Official  Statistical  News  for  the Third  Quarter  of  2022  which  was  published  by  the Central Bureau of Statistics, the field production of health  services  and  social  activities  experienced the highest growth of up to 7.12% from the previous quarter  (qtoq),  but  contracted  by  ­1.74%  from  the third quarter of 2021 (yoy). However, the health sector is  claimed  to  have  succeeded  in  recording various positive  achievements  throughout  2022,  starting from  Covid­19 handling and vaccination, as well as health transformation.

Kinerja Rumah Sakit yang melesu pada tahun 2022 di  antaranya  disebabkan  oleh  adanya  penurunan gelombang  Covid-19  yang  juga  diperkuat  dengan diakhirinya PPKM oleh Presiden Joko Widodo pada akhir tahun 2022. Selain itu, sentimen negatif akibat  turunnya  nilai  tukar  Rupiah  terhadap  Dolar Amerika  Serikat  juga  memberatkan  kinerja  rumah sakit di sepanjang tahun 2022.

Primaya Hospital Group  dan  Entitas Anak  memiliki serangkaian strategi usaha untuk mencapai pertumbuhan sekaligus untuk mendukung Perseroan menghadapi persaingan usaha, di antaranya:

## 1. Memberikan pelayanan kesehatan yang prima, terjangkau  yang dapat diakses oleh masyarakat

Grup Primaya Hospital berfokus untuk mempertahankan  kualitas  pelayanan  Kesehatan  pada  seluruh  jaringan  rumah  sakit  dengan menerapkan standard operating procedure dan kebijakan yang memenuhi standar JCI yang tinggi. Grup Primaya Hospital akan selalu  berusaha  mengembangkan  pelayanan Kesehatan berdasarkan pertumbuhan dari permintaan pasien. Implementasi internal  audit dan survei dilakukan secara periodik untuk memastikan seluruh rumah sakit memenuhi standard  operating  procedure dan  kebijakan tersebut .

The Hospital performance, which weakened in 2022, resulted  from  the  decrease  of  Covid­19  wave  and was reinforced by the ending of community activities restrictions (PPKM) by President Joko Widodo in the end of 2022. In addition, negative sentiment due to the  decrease  in  the  Rupiah  exchange  rate  against the United States Dollar also affected the hospital's performance throughout 2022.

Primaya  Hospital  Group  and  its  Subsidiaries  have a  series  of  business  strategies  to  achieve  growth as  well  as  to  support  the  Company  in  overcoming business competition, as follows:

1. Providing  excellent  and  affordable  healthcare services  that  could  be  easily  accessed  by  the society

Primaya  Hospital  Group  focuses  to  maintain healthcare services quality at its entire hospital chains by implementing standard operating procedure and the policies complying to the high standard of JCI. Primaya Hospital Group always strives to develop healthcare services based on the growth of patient's demands. Internal audits and surveys arecarried out periodically to ensure that  all  hospitals  comply  with  these  standard operating procedures and policies.

Grup Primaya Hospital berencana untuk meningkatkan  kesadaran  merek  untuk  mempermudah ekspansi yang optimal. Grup Primaya Hospital juga akan selalu mengutamakan economies of scale dengan memanfaatkan ekosistem dan jaringan rumah sakit dan layanan penunjang kesehatan Perseroan dengan baik.  Selanjutnya  Grup  Primaya Hospital juga memanfaatkan cross-referrals yang  diperoleh dari  jaringan  rumah  sakit  dan/atau  layanan penunjang  kesehatan  Grup  Primaya Hospital dalam suatu klaster.

## 5.  Pertumbuhan Grup Primaya Hospital yang dijalankan secara berkesinambungan

Grup  Primaya Hospital akan  terus  berupaya meningkatkan kinerja operasional secara organik. Grup Primaya Hospital juga akan mengimplementasi blueprint yang akurat untuk membangun rumah sakit baru dan/ atau  mengakuisisi  rumah  sakit  yang  memiliki potensi.  Dengan membuat blueprint yang telah dipertimbangkan secara matang, Grup Primaya Hospital dapat membangun rumah sakit dengan biaya  yang  kompetitif  dan  waktu  relatif  cepat dibandingkan  dengan  pesaingnya.  Selain itu reputasi dari pendiri Grup Primaya Hospital yang telah  membangun  lebih  dari  30  rumah  sakit  di Indonesia, didukung oleh tim manajemen proyek, tim  medis,  tim  perawat,  tim  keuangan  dan  tim sumber daya manusia menjadikan rencana pengembangan  kegiatan  usaha  Grup  Primaya Hospital lebih komprehensif, disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan  wilayah regional  di  mana  rumah sakit  akan  dibangun  dan/atau  dikembangkan, dan pada akhirnya dapat memberikan pelayanan  kesehatan  yang  berkualitas  dalam rangka  meningkatkan  kesembuhan  pasiennya. Sampai  dengan  tangggal  31  Desember  2022, Grup  Primaya Hospital memiliki  15  rumah  sakit yang  telah  beroperasi  dan  layanan  penunjang kesehatan seperti laboratorium klinis, homecare , dan layanan lain seperti telemedicine yang telah dijalankan secara berkesinambungan.

6.  Mempertahankan  sumber  daya  utama  yakni dokter, perawat, dan  tenaga  medis  lainnya melalui lingkungan dan budaya yang positif dan berkualitas serta model bisnis yang berorientasi pada volume yang tinggi

Grup Primaya Hospital mampu mempertahankan nilai-nilai tersebut dan merekrut  dokter  dengan  jumlah  pertumbuhan sebesar 21,4% selama 2019­2021.

Besides, the reputation of Primaya Hospital  Group  founders  who  have  established 30  hospitals  in  Indonesia,  supported  by  project management team, medical team, nursing team, finance team, and human resources team transform the planning of business development agenda  of  Primaya  Hospital  Group  to  be  more comprehensive, adjusted to the needs of regional areas  where  the  hospitals  will  be  built  and/ or  developed,  and  in  the  end  it  is  expected  to provide  quality  healthcare  services  to  increase the  patient  recovery.  Until  December  31,  2022, Primaya Hospital Group has managed 15 operating  hospitals  and  healthcare  supporting services such as clinical laboratories, homecare, and  other  services  such  as  telemedicine  that have been implemented on an ongoing basis.

6. Maintaining primary resources, such as doctors, nurses, and other medical experts through positive  and  quality  environment  and  culture and high-volume-oriented business model

In general, good and sustainable hospital ecosystem, high-volume-oriented business model,  and  positive  and  high  quality  company environment  and  culture  are  significant  factors to  maintain  primary  hospital  resources,  such as  doctros,  nurses,  and  other  medical  experts. Primaya Hospital Group was able to retain those values  and  recruit  doctors  with  21.4%  growth during 2019-2021.

## TINJAUAN OPERASI PER SEGMEN USAHA

OPERATIONAL OVERVIEW PER BUSINESS SEGMENT

Perseroan mengelola 15 rumah sakit yang tergabung di  Grup  Primaya Hospital yang  tersebar  di  seluruh Indonesia.  Perseroan  berkeyakinan  bahwa  masih terdapat  berbagai  peluang  di  sektor  Kesehatan di Indonesia seiring  berkembangnya  pelayanan Kesehatan di Indonesia. Adapun per  tumbuhan pelayanan  Kesehatan  di  Indonesia  erat  kaitannya dengan peningkatan populasi penduduk umur produktif, peningkatan pendapatan, penduduk kelas menengah, peningkatan konsumsi Kesehatan masyarakat, hingga adanya penyelenggaraan program  Jaminan  Kesehatan  Nasional  (JKN)  yang merata  dan  menyeluruh  bagi  seluruh  masyarakat Indonesia.  Oleh  sebab  itu,  rumah  sakit  menjadi salah satu bisnis utama yang mendukung operasional bisnis Perseroan.

Seperti  yang  telah  dijelaskan  sebelumnya,  kinerja industri rumah sakit di sepanjang tahun 2022 dilaporkan  tidak  sebaik  di  tahun  sebelumnya.  Hal ini  diakibatkan  oleh  meredanya  pandemi  Covid-19 hingga dihentikannya PPKM oleh Pemerintah sehingga  melahirkan  sentimen  negatif  terhadap industri  rumah  sakit.  Melemahnya  kinerja  Rupiah terhadap  Dolar  Amerika  Serikat  juga  turut  mendukung  adanya  penurunan  kinerja  bisnis  industri rumah sakit.

Sementara pada industri kesehatan secara general ,  Laporan  Pertumbuhan  Ekonomi  Indonesia triwulan IV­2022 yang dirilis BPS menyebutkan industri kesehatan dan kegiatan sosial  tumbuh sebesar 2,74% dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelumnya. Namun demikian, Bank Indonesia melalui Laporan Perekonomian Indonesia 2022 menyebutkan per  tumbuhan industri kesehatan berdasarkan  lapangan  usaha  menurun  1,74%.  Hal ini  disebabkan  oleh  pencairan  insentif  kesehatan yang menurun dibandingkan kuartal maupun tahun sebelumnya,  sehingga  menyebabkan  terkontraksinya per  tumbuhan jasa kesehatan.

Penguatan  industri  kesehatan  di  tingkat  domestik menjadi  hal  yang  penting  untuk  memanfaatkan kolaborasi  manufaktur  dan  pusat-pusat  penelitian serta pengembangan vaksin, obat-obatan serta alat diagnostik. Hal ini disebabkan oleh menurunnya tingkat Covid-19 sehingga permintaan layanan  kesehatan  non-Covid  menjadi  tumpuan bagi industri kesehatan pada tahun mendatang.

The Company manages 15 hospitals that are members  of  the  Primaya  Hospital  Group  which are  spread  throughout  Indonesia.    The  Company believes  that  there  are  still  various  opportunities in  the  health  sector  in  Indonesia  in  line  with  the development  of  health  services  in  Indonesia.    The growth  of  the  healthcare  in  Indonesia  is  closely related to the increase in the population of productive  age,  increased  income,  middle  class population, increased consumption of public health, and  the  implementation  of  the  National  Health Insurance  (JKN)  program  that  is  evenly  distributed and comprehensive for all Indonesian people. Therefore,  hospitals  are  one  of  the  main  businesses that support the Company's business operations.

As  previously  explained,  the  performance  of  the hospital industry throughout 2022 was not as good as in the previous year.  This resulted from the easing of the Covid-19  pandemic  and  the  termination of  PPKM  by  the  Government,  which  resulted  in negative  sentiment  towards  the  hospital  industry. The weakening performance of the Rupiah against the  US  Dollar  also  contributed  to  the  decline  in the business performance of the hospital industry.

Meanwhile  for  the  health  industry  in  general,  the Indonesian  Economic  Growth  Report for the fourth quarter  of  2022  released  by  BPS  stated  that  the health industry and social activities grew by 2.74% compared  to  the  previous  year.    However,  Bank Indonesia, through the Indonesian Economic Report 2022 stated that the growth of the health industry based  on  business  field  decreased  by  1.74%.    This was  due  to  the  disbursement  of  health  incentives which decreased from the previous quarter and year, resulting  in  a  contraction  in  the  growth  of  health services.

The expansion of the health industry at the domestic  level  is  important  to  utilize  collaborative manufacturing  and  research  centers  and  development  of  vaccines,  medicines  and  diagnostic  tools. This is due to the declining level of Covid-19 so the demand for non-Covid health services become the foundation for the health industry in the coming year.
